info.name: Prana Earth — Admin User Management
info.description:
Server Actions for the Admin User Management panel.

All requests are Next.js Server Actions called via POST to /api/... proxy routes.
For local testing, these actions can be called directly from the Next.js app.

**Auth:** All endpoints require an active admin session cookie (access_token).

**Base URL:** http://localhost:3000

request.description:
Server Action: getAdminUsers()
Import: import { getAdminUsers } from '@/actions/admin-user-management.actions';

Returns paginated list of ALL users (role=USER, not deleted).
Includes: organization name, active plan, last login, isActive status.

query.description: Matches fullName, email, or organization name
Returns users with MARKETPLACE or BUNDLE active subscription
Returns users with PREDICT or BUNDLE active subscription
Returns users with any active paid subscription

request.description:
Server Action: getAdminUsers({ plan: 'MARKETPLACE' })
Import: import { getAdminUsers } from '@/actions/admin-user-management.actions';

Plan values:
- FREE → users with NO active paid subscription
- PREDICT → active PREDICT plan only
- MARKETPLACE → active MARKETPLACE plan only
- BUNDLE → active BUNDLE plan only

Server Action: getAdminUserDetails(userId)
Import: import { getAdminUserDetails } from '@/actions/admin-user-management.actions';

Returns:
- Basic Info: fullName, email, phone, avatarUrl, jobTitle, countryRegion
- Organization: id, name, slug, industry, memberRole, joinedAt
- Subscription: planName, planType, billingCycle, status, startsAt, expiresAt, priceMonthly, priceYearly
- Payments: Array of { id, amount, currency, status, paymentProvider, paidAt, planName, planType }

Subscription = null means FREE tier (never purchased).
